from pathlib import Path

old, body = rest.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)

for before, after in [
('chali ek','chali ik'), ('e-gurbat','e-ghurbat'), ('shaheedo ','shahidoṅ '),
('huvi alveda','hui alwida'), (' zainab',' Zainab'), ('apne hai\\n','apne haiṅ\\n'),

item.text:
Audited all 53 Roman verse lines against the Urdu in [na-des-apna-hai.md](src/data/lyrics/na-des-apna-hai.md). Corrected nasal endings, vowel spellings, izafat, proper names, and refrain punctuation. Verified line alignment and preserved the Urdu body byte for byte.

The reading `beghar` remains provisional because the Urdu reads `ے گھر`.
